completion_data.completion_summary: Landed the Scope-Hypothesis/task-list self-consistency obligation and the correction-target existence obligation as prose in the core extension's plan-format.md, added two generation-time pointer items to planner-agent.md's Stage 4 checklist, reconciled index-entries.json's line_count to 1083, and redeployed to RESULT=landed_verify_clean with the full gate set passing (15 checks, 0 failures). The mechanical-check question was investigated and decided: no sound correction-target-versus-creation-target discrimination is buildable from the current Files to modify grammar, so nothing was built.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan edit targets a source-store repository distinct from the task's own repository (cross-repo siting, e.g. a BimodalLogic-numbered task editing agent-system/extensions/core/** which only resolves under a separate ~/.config/nvim checkout), the implementer should not attempt a git commit in that foreign repo using the task's own numbering convention -- it misattributes provenance in a repo with its own independent task space, and the dispatch contract for this pattern names no such commit requirement. Leave the edit as an uncommitted working-tree change in that repo; deploy-headless.sh reads the working tree directly, not a commit, so this does not block redeploy verification.

git-commit-phase.sh correctly drops (with a WARN, non-fatal) a files_touched pathspec entry that resolves outside the current repository's working tree (e.g. an absolute path under a different repo's checkout) rather than failing the commit -- this is the expected, benign behavior when a phase's real edits live in an external source-store repo and only the task-tracking artifacts (plan checkboxes, progress files, handoffs) live in the current repo.
